# SwanDigitals

> Enterprise AI Solutions
> https://swandigitals.com
> New: Voice AI in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi + English

## What We Do
SwanDigitals builds personalized AI chatbots and voice agents for Indian enterprises. On-premise, cloud, or hybrid deployment. 10+ Indian languages. WhatsApp, Web, and Phone — all launched in one week.

## Core Products
- **Conversational AI**: Natural, multi-turn conversations in 10+ Indian languages with context-aware intent and sentiment understanding
- **Voice AI Agents**: Human-like phone conversations with <500ms latency, replacing traditional IVR systems
- **Omnichannel Platform**: WhatsApp, Web, Voice, Slack, Teams, Instagram — one bot handles all channels
- **On-Premise Deployment**: True air-gapped deployment for banking, healthcare, and government

## Key Differentiators
- **1-Week Deployment**: Build and launch personalized AI agents in 7 days (vs 60-90 days for competitors)
- **Zero Data Collection**: Your data stays yours — we never collect or store conversation data, even on our cloud
- **Data Sovereignty**: 100% air-gapped deployment option, data stays in India, RBI and DPDP 2023 ready
- **Flat Pricing**: No per-conversation fees, unlimited usage, predictable costs
- **Multi-language**: Native support for Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi, and 5+ other Indian languages

## Solutions by Industry
- **Banking & NBFC**: RBI-ready architecture, AES-256 encryption, audit logging
- **Healthcare**: HIPAA-compliant design, patient data protection
- **Government**: Air-gapped deployment, complete offline capability
- **E-commerce**: WhatsApp commerce, inventory integration
- **IT Services**: Employee helpdesk, ITSM integration

## Pricing (Indicative)
- **Pilot/PoV**: ₹10,000 one-time (refundable on conversion)
- **Growth**: ₹12,000/month (10k WhatsApp conversations or 1k voice minutes)
- **Professional**: ₹28,000/month (30k conversations or 5k voice minutes, includes Voice AI)
- **Enterprise**: Custom pricing (on-premise, unlimited conversations, named CSM)

## Main Competitors
- **vs Kore.ai**: 1 week deployment vs 3-6 months, we build WITH you (not DIY), flat pricing
- **vs Yellow.ai**: True on-premise (not dedicated VPC), zero data collection, no vendor lock-in
- **vs Intercom**: Full data sovereignty, Indian language support, no usage-based pricing
- **vs Zendesk**: AI-first platform, voice AI included, omnichannel from day one

## Security & Compliance
- AES-256 encryption at rest and in transit
- India data residency (Mumbai-based)
- Air-gapped deployment option
- RBAC & SSO (SAML 2.0/OIDC)
- Audit logging for compliance
- DPDP 2023 ready architecture

## Integrations (100+)
- **CRM**: Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho
- **Helpdesk**: Zendesk, Freshdesk, ServiceNow
- **Messaging**: WhatsApp, Slack, Teams
- **Core Banking**: Infosys Finacle, Temenos
- **E-commerce**: Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento
- **Payments**: Razorpay, Stripe
